multipleChoice.sentence: The moon ___ around the Earth once a month.

multipleChoice.sentence: My neighbours ___ their dog for a walk every evening.

multipleChoice.sentence: This kind of flower ___ in very dry places.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这种花生长在非常干燥的地方。【解析】主语 This kind of flower 为单数，一般现在时描述客观事实，动词用 grows。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ a big family dinner on New Year's Eve every year.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们每年除夕都吃一顿丰盛的家庭晚餐。【解析】主语 We 是复数，一般现在时描述年度习惯，动词用原形 have。

multipleChoice.sentence: The first train of the day ___ at 5:30 in the morning.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】每天的第一班火车早上五点半发车。【解析】主语 The first train 是单数，一般现在时描述固定时刻表，动词用 leaves。

multipleChoice.sentence: Listen! Someone ___ the piano in the next room.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】听！有人在隔壁房间弹钢琴。【解析】Listen! 提示动作正在发生，主语 someone 是单数，现在进行时用 is playing。

multipleChoice.sentence: Be quiet! The baby ___ in the bedroom.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】安静！宝宝正在卧室睡觉。【解析】Be quiet! 提示动作正在进行，主语 The baby 是三单，现在进行时用 is sleeping。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ for the bus at the moment.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们此刻正在等公交车。【解析】at the moment 提示此刻正在发生，主语 We 是复数，现在进行时用 are waiting。

multipleChoice.sentence: The students ___ an experiment in the laboratory now.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】学生们此刻正在实验室里做实验。【解析】now 提示正在发生，主语 The students 是复数，现在进行时用 are doing。

multipleChoice.sentence: My sister ___ her room. Please don't disturb her.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我妹妹正在打扫她的房间。请不要打扰她。【解析】后句提示当前不要打扰，说明正在打扫，主语 My sister 是三单，用 is cleaning。

multipleChoice.sentence: The population of the world ___ very fast.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】世界人口正在快速增长。【解析】表示现阶段正在发生的变化趋势，主语 The population 是单数，现在进行时用 is growing。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ a letter to my pen friend in Australia this week.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我这周正在给澳大利亚的笔友写信。【解析】this week 表示现阶段正在进行的动作，主语 I，用 am writing。

multipleChoice.sentence: Why ___ you ___ at me like that?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你为什么那样看着我？【解析】问此刻正在发生的动作，主语 you 是复数，现在进行时用 are...looking。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ a strange noise outside my window last night.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】昨晚我听到窗外有奇怪的声音。【解析】last night 表示过去的时间点，动词用过去式，hear 的过去式是 heard。

multipleChoice.sentence: My grandmother ___ a lot of vegetables in her garden last summer.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我奶奶去年夏天在菜园里种了很多蔬菜。【解析】last summer 表示过去的时间段，动词用过去式，grow 的过去式是 grew。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ the whole afternoon playing chess in the park.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们整个下午都在公园里下棋。【解析】描述过去某个时间段的活动，动词用过去式，spend 的过去式是 spent。

multipleChoice.sentence: The train ___ five minutes late this morning.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】今天早上火车晚点了五分钟。【解析】this morning 表示过去的时间，动词用过去式，arrive 的过去式是 arrived。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ my wallet on the bus yesterday and never found it.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我昨天把钱包落在公交车上了，再也没找到。【解析】yesterday 表示过去的时间，lost 表示过去的动作，lose 的过去式是 lost。

multipleChoice.sentence: The concert ___ at 8 p.m. and ended at 10 p.m.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】音乐会晚上八点开始，十点结束。【解析】音乐会已经发生，ended 提示过去时，start 的过去式是 started。

multipleChoice.sentence: When I was a child, my father ___ me to school every day.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我小时候，我爸爸每天送我去上学。【解析】When I was a child 表示过去的时间段，took 表示过去习惯性动作，take 的过去式是 took。

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ the exam easily because she had prepared well.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她轻松通过了考试，因为她准备得很充分。【解析】描述过去已完成的事件，用一般过去时，pass 的过去式是 passed。

multipleChoice.sentence: The car ___ down on the highway yesterday morning.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】昨天早上那辆车在高速公路上抛锚了。【解析】yesterday morning 表示过去具体时间，描述突然事件，break 的过去式是 broke。

multipleChoice.sentence: My friends ___ me to their new house last weekend.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我朋友们上周末邀请我去他们的新家。【解析】last weekend 表示过去时间，invite 的过去式是 invited。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ a school trip to the museum next Friday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们下周五将有一次去博物馆的学校旅行。【解析】next Friday 表示将来时间，will have 表示将来发生的动作。

multipleChoice.sentence: My father ___ me a new bicycle for my birthday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我爸爸会在我生日时给我一辆新自行车。【解析】for my birthday 表示将来时间，will give 表示将来的承诺或打算。

multipleChoice.sentence: I'm not sure if I ___ free tomorrow.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我不确定明天是否有空。【解析】tomorrow 表示将来时间，will be 表示将来的状态，if 从句中也可以用 will。

multipleChoice.sentence: The train ___ at 6:30 tomorrow morning, so we have to get up early.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】火车明早六点半发车，所以我们得早起。【解析】按时刻表发生的事件，用一般现在时表将来，leaves 表示固定安排。

multipleChoice.sentence: Don't worry. I ___ you with your homework later.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】别担心。我待会儿会帮你做作业。【解析】later 表示将来时间，will help 表示主动提供的帮助。

multipleChoice.sentence: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】如果明天下雨，我们就取消野餐。【解析】if 条件句中用一般现在时表将来，rains 表示将来的条件。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ a test next week, so I need to start preparing.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们下周有一次考试，所以我得开始准备了。【解析】next week 表示将来时间，will have 表示将来安排的事件。

multipleChoice.sentence: The concert ___ in half an hour. We'd better hurry.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】音乐会半小时后开始。我们最好快点。【解析】按固定时间表发生的事件，用一般现在时表将来，starts 表示固定安排。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ you at the airport when you arrive.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你到的时候我会去机场接你。【解析】when you arrive 表示将来时间，will meet 表示将来的动作。

multipleChoice.sentence: They ___ the new bridge next year, I heard.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我听说他们明年会建好那座新桥。【解析】next year 表示将来时间，will complete 表示将来完成的事件。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ my keys. Has anyone seen them?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我把钥匙弄丢了。有人看见了吗？【解析】强调对现在的影响（钥匙不见了），用现在完成时 have lost。

multipleChoice.sentence: My sister ___ in Beijing since 2018.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我姐姐从2018年起就一直住在北京。【解析】since 2018 表示从过去持续到现在的动作，用现在完成时 has lived。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ the movie twice already.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这部电影我已经看过两遍了。【解析】already 和 twice 表示过去发生对现在有影响的经历，用 have seen。

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ from the university yet.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她还没从大学毕业。【解析】yet 用于否定句中表示“还没”，用现在完成时 hasn't graduated。

multipleChoice.sentence: They ___ each other for more than ten years.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他们认识彼此已经十多年了。【解析】for more than ten years 表示持续一段时间，用现在完成时 have known。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ you ___ any interesting books recently?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你最近读了什么有趣的书吗？【解析】recently 表示最近一段时间，用现在完成时 Have...read。

multipleChoice.sentence: My parents ___ never ___ abroad.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我父母从未出过国。【解析】never 强调从过去到现在的经历，用现在完成时 have...been。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ my homework yet, but I'll do it now.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我还没做完作业，不过我现在就做。【解析】yet 用于否定句，表示“还没完成”，用 haven't finished。

multipleChoice.sentence: This is the first time I ___ Chinese food.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这是我第一次尝试中餐。【解析】This is the first time 句型用现在完成时，have tried。

multipleChoice.sentence: The company ___ a lot of new workers this year.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这家公司今年招了很多新员工。【解析】this year 表示包括现在的时间段，用现在完成时 has hired。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ a book when the lights suddenly went out.

multipleChoice.sentence: My brother ___ his bike when it started to rain heavily.

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ dinner at 7 p.m. yesterday when you called.

multipleChoice.sentence: The students ___ quietly when the headmaster entered the room.

multipleChoice.sentence: My father ___ the newspaper while my mother was cooking in the kitchen.

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ for the bus when she saw the accident.

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ to the radio when my sister came in and turned it off.

multipleChoice.sentence: The children ___ football in the yard when their mother called them for dinner.

multipleChoice.sentence: While I ___ for the train, I met an old friend.

multipleChoice.sentence: My grandmother ___ in the garden when I got home from school.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我放学回家时，我奶奶正在花园里干活。【解析】when 引导的短暂动作（got home）发生时，正在进行的动作（干活）用过去进行时 was working。

multipleChoice.sentence: She said she ___ me as soon as she arrived in Beijing.

multipleChoice.sentence: My father told me that he ___ a new car the next month.

multipleChoice.sentence: I thought we ___ late if we didn't hurry up.

multipleChoice.sentence: He asked me whether I ___ to the party with him the next weekend.

multipleChoice.sentence: She hoped that her son ___ a good grade in the exam.

multipleChoice.sentence: I knew that the meeting ___ at 3 p.m. the next day.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我知道会议将在第二天下午三点开始。【解析】the next day 表示从过去角度看将来，主句 knew 是过去时，用 would start。

multipleChoice.sentence: The teacher said we ___ a test the following week.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】老师说我们下周有一次考试。【解析】the following week 表示从过去角度看将来，主句 said 是过去时，用 would have。

multipleChoice.sentence: They promised they ___ the work before Friday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他们承诺会在周五前完成工作。【解析】promised 是过去时，承诺的内容是将来的事，用过去将来时 would finish。

multipleChoice.sentence: I was worried that my parents ___ about the broken window.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我担心我父母会发现那扇打碎的窗户。【解析】worried 是过去时，担心的事是将来的事，用过去将来时 would find。

multipleChoice.sentence: She told me she ___ a doctor when she grew up.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她告诉我她长大后想当一名医生。【解析】told 是过去时，从句表示从过去看将来长大后的理想，用 would be。

multipleChoice.sentence: I realized I ___ my keys when I got home.

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ never ___ a horse before she visited the farm.

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ my homework by the time my mom got home.

multipleChoice.sentence: She told me she ___ the movie three times.

multipleChoice.sentence: The train ___ when we arrived at the station.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们到火车站时火车已经开走了。【解析】“到达车站”是过去动作，“火车开走”发生在此之前，用过去完成时 had left。

multipleChoice.sentence: By the time I was twelve, I ___ five different schools.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】到十二岁时，我已经上过五所不同的学校了。【解析】“十二岁时”是过去时间点，“上过五所学校”在此之前发生并累积，用过去完成时 had attended。

multipleChoice.sentence: She was sad because her dog ___ away.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她很伤心，因为她的狗跑了。【解析】“她很伤心”是过去状态，“狗跑了”发生在此之前并导致其伤心，用过去完成时 had run。

multipleChoice.sentence: I wanted to go swimming, but I ___ my swimsuit.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我想去游泳，但我忘记带泳衣了。【解析】“想去游泳”是过去想法，“忘记带泳衣”在此之前，用过去完成时 had forgot。

multipleChoice.sentence: He ___ English for three years before he moved to London.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他在搬到伦敦之前已经学了三年英语。【解析】“搬到伦敦”是过去动作，“学了三年”在此之前，用过去完成时 had learned。

multipleChoice.sentence: The flowers ___ because nobody watered them.

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ a big tree in front of our school.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们学校前面有一棵大树。【解析】主语 a big tree 是单数，描述客观存在，用 There is。

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ some coffee left in the cup.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】杯子里还剩一些咖啡。【解析】coffee 是不可数名词，There be 用单数 is。

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ many people waiting outside the cinema.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】电影院外面有很多人在等着。【解析】主语 many people 是复数，用 There are。

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ a meeting in the hall tomorrow afternoon.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】明天下午大厅里有一个会议。【解析】tomorrow afternoon 表示将来时间，用 There will be。

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ a lot of rain last summer.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】去年夏天下了很多雨。【解析】last summer 表示过去时间，rain 是不可数名词，用 There was。

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ a hospital near here?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这附近有医院吗？【解析】问附近是否有医院，主语 a hospital 是单数，疑问句用 Is there。

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ no milk in the fridge. We need to buy some.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】冰箱里没有牛奶了。我们需要买一些。【解析】milk 是不可数名词，用 There is。

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ a concert in the park next Sunday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】下周日公园里有一场音乐会。【解析】next Sunday 表示将来时间，用 There will be。

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ a lot of snow in the north every winter.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】北方每年冬天都有很多雪。【解析】snow 是不可数名词，描述客观现象，用 There is。

multipleChoice.sentence: There ___ a phone call for you just now.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】刚才有你的一个电话。【解析】just now 表示过去时间，主语 a phone call 是单数，用 There was。

multipleChoice.sentence: The little boy ___ in the park every afternoon.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那个小男孩每天下午都在公园里玩。【解析】主语 The little boy 是单数，谓语动词用 plays。

multipleChoice.sentence: My friends ___ to the cinema every weekend.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我的朋友们每周末都去看电影。【解析】主语 My friends 是复数，谓语动词用原形 go。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ often help their mother with housework.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我的姐姐们经常帮妈妈做家务。【解析】谓语 help 是原形，说明主语是复数，My sisters 符合。

multipleChoice.sentence: The teacher and the students ___ in the classroom now.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】老师和学生们现在都在教室里。【解析】主语 The teacher and the students 是复数，谓语用 are。

multipleChoice.sentence: His father ___ a doctor.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他爸爸是一名医生。【解析】主语 His father 是单数，谓语用 is。

multipleChoice.sentence: Reading books ___ me happy.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】读书让我开心。【解析】动名词 Reading books 作主语，视为单数，谓语用 makes。

multipleChoice.sentence: The news ___ very surprising.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这个消息非常令人惊讶。【解析】news 是不可数名词，作主语视为单数，谓语用 is。

multipleChoice.sentence: My mother and my aunt ___ in the same hospital.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我妈妈和我阿姨在同一家医院工作。【解析】主语 My mother and my aunt 是复数，谓语用原形 work。

multipleChoice.sentence: The boy with his parents ___ in the garden.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那个男孩和他的父母在花园里散步。【解析】主语是 The boy（单数），with his parents 是修饰语，谓语用 walks。

multipleChoice.sentence: Chinese ___ by more and more people around the world.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】全世界越来越多的人说中文。【解析】Chinese 作主语，表示“中文”，与 speak 是被动关系，用 is spoken。

multipleChoice.sentence: Not only my friends but also my teacher ___ to the concert.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】不仅是我的朋友，我的老师也要去音乐会。【解析】not only...but also... 就近原则，谓语与 my teacher 一致，用 goes。

multipleChoice.sentence: The pair of shoes ___ very comfortable.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这双鞋穿起来很舒服。【解析】主语是 The pair（单数），of shoes 是修饰语，谓语用 looks。

multipleChoice.sentence: Both my brother and my sister ___ playing the piano.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我的哥哥和姐姐都喜欢弹钢琴。【解析】both...and... 连接两个主语，谓语用复数原形 enjoy。

multipleChoice.sentence: Where ___ your parents during the holiday?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你父母在假期期间去了哪里？【解析】主语 your parents 是复数，过去时用 were。

multipleChoice.sentence: She is one of the students who ___ to school by bike.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她是那些骑自行车上学的学生之一。【解析】who 指代先行词 students（复数），谓语用原形 go。

multipleChoice.sentence: My sister ___ a new bicycle for her birthday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我妹妹收到了一辆新自行车作为生日礼物。【解析】主语 My sister 是单数，谓语 receives，宾语 a new bicycle。

multipleChoice.sentence: The children ___ their homework in the classroom now.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】孩子们此刻正在教室里做作业。【解析】主语 The children 是复数，谓语 are doing，宾语 their homework。

multipleChoice.sentence: My mother ___ a cake for us every Sunday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我妈妈每个星期天都给我们做蛋糕。【解析】主语 My mother 是单数，谓语 makes，宾语 a cake。

multipleChoice.sentence: The teacher ___ the students a story yesterday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】老师昨天给学生们讲了一个故事。【解析】yesterday 表示过去，谓语 told，宾语 the students 和 a story（双宾语）。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ an interesting book in the library yesterday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我昨天在图书馆找到了一本有趣的书。【解析】yesterday 表示过去，谓语 found，宾语 an interesting book。

multipleChoice.sentence: My grandparents ___ us every weekend.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我的祖父母每个周末都来看我们。【解析】主语 My grandparents 是复数，谓语用原形 visit，宾语 us。

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ a letter to her friend right now.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她正在给她的朋友写信。【解析】right now 提示正在发生，谓语 is writing，宾语 a letter。

multipleChoice.sentence: The dog ___ the ball happily in the yard.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那只狗正在院子里开心地追球。【解析】主语 The dog 是单数，谓语 chases，宾语 the ball。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ a movie at the cinema tomorrow.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们明天要去电影院看电影。【解析】tomorrow 表示将来，谓语 will watch，宾语 a movie。

multipleChoice.sentence: The students ___ the classroom every day.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】学生们每天都打扫教室。【解析】主语 The students 是复数，谓语用原形 clean，宾语 the classroom。

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ her keys again yesterday morning.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她昨天早上又把钥匙弄丢了。【解析】yesterday morning 表示过去，谓语 lost，宾语 her keys。

multipleChoice.sentence: My brother ___ to music every evening.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我弟弟每天晚上都听音乐。【解析】主语 My brother 是单数，谓语 listens，宾语 to music。

multipleChoice.sentence: The workers ___ a new bridge near our school.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】工人们正在我们学校附近建一座新桥。【解析】are building 表示现在进行，宾语 a new bridge。

multipleChoice.sentence: My father ___ his car every Saturday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我爸爸每个星期六都洗车。【解析】主语 My father 是单数，谓语 washes，宾语 his car。

multipleChoice.sentence: The children ___ a lot of noise in the classroom.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】孩子们在教室里制造了很多噪音。【解析】主语 The children 是复数，但此句为一般现在时，谓语用原形 make，宾语 a lot of noise。干扰项 B 为 makes，已修正。

multipleChoice.sentence: The flowers in the garden ___ beautiful in spring.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】花园里的花在春天看起来很漂亮。【解析】主语 The flowers 是复数，系动词用原形 look，表语 beautiful 说明主语特征。

multipleChoice.sentence: This soup ___ delicious. I'd like another bowl.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这汤尝起来很美味。我想再来一碗。【解析】主语 This soup 是单数，系动词用 tastes，表语 delicious 说明味道特征。

multipleChoice.sentence: My grandmother ___ still very healthy at the age of 80.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我奶奶在80岁时仍然非常健康。【解析】主语 My grandmother 是单数，系动词用 is，表语 healthy 说明状态。

multipleChoice.sentence: The news on TV ___ very surprising.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】电视上的新闻非常令人惊讶。【解析】news 是不可数名词，作主语视为单数，系动词用 is，表语 surprising 说明特征。

multipleChoice.sentence: These shoes ___ too small for me.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这双鞋对我来说太小了。【解析】主语 These shoes 是复数，系动词用 are，表语 small 说明特征。

multipleChoice.sentence: His dream ___ to become a famous writer.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他的梦想是成为一名著名作家。【解析】主语 His dream 是单数，系动词用 is，表语 to become a famous writer 说明内容。

multipleChoice.sentence: The children ___ very excited about the school trip.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】孩子们对学校旅行非常兴奋。【解析】主语 The children 是复数，系动词用 are，表语 excited 说明情绪状态。

multipleChoice.sentence: This kind of bamboo ___ very strong.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这种竹子非常结实。【解析】主语 This kind of bamboo 是单数（kind 为单数），系动词用 is，表语 strong 说明特征。

multipleChoice.sentence: My sister ___ a teacher in a primary school.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我姐姐是一名小学老师。【解析】主语 My sister 是单数，系动词用 is，表语 a teacher 说明身份。

multipleChoice.sentence: The cake ___ good. Can I have another piece?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这蛋糕味道不错。我能再来一块吗？【解析】主语 The cake 是单数，系动词用 tastes，表语 good 说明味道。

multipleChoice.sentence: Reading books ___ very interesting to me.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】读书对我来说非常有趣。【解析】动名词 Reading books 作主语，视为单数，系动词用 is，表语 interesting 说明特征。

multipleChoice.sentence: The students in our class ___ very friendly.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们班的学生们非常友好。【解析】主语 The students 是复数，系动词用 are，表语 friendly 说明特征。

multipleChoice.sentence: Where ___ my glasses? I can't find them.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我的眼镜在哪里？我找不到了。【解析】glasses（眼镜）用复数形式，系动词用 are，表语地点状语省略。

multipleChoice.sentence: My parents ___ very proud of me.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我的父母为我感到非常骄傲。【解析】主语 My parents 是复数，系动词用 are，表语 proud 说明情感状态。

multipleChoice.sentence: The little boy ___ afraid of the dark.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那个小男孩害怕黑暗。【解析】主语 The little boy 是单数，系动词用 is，表语 afraid 说明心理状态。

multipleChoice.sentence: This song ___ beautiful. I could listen to it all day.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这首歌听起来很美。我能听一整天。【解析】sounds 是感官系动词，表语 beautiful 说明听觉感受。

multipleChoice.sentence: The flowers in this garden ___ wonderful in spring.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这个花园里的花在春天闻起来很香。【解析】smell 是感官系动词，表语 wonderful 说明嗅觉感受。

multipleChoice.sentence: The soup ___ a little salty. I think I put too much salt.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这汤尝起来有点咸。我觉得我放太多盐了。【解析】tastes 是感官系动词，表语 salty 说明味觉感受。

multipleChoice.sentence: This silk scarf ___ so soft against my skin.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这条丝巾摸在皮肤上很柔软。【解析】feels 是感官系动词，表语 soft 说明触觉感受。

multipleChoice.sentence: The weather ___ colder and colder as winter comes.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】随着冬天的到来，天气变得越来越冷。【解析】gets 是变化类系动词，表语 colder 说明变化趋势。

multipleChoice.sentence: His face ___ red when he heard the news.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他听到这个消息时脸变红了。【解析】turned 是变化类系动词，表语 red 说明颜色变化。

multipleChoice.sentence: Please ___ calm and wait for further instructions.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】请保持冷静，等待进一步的指示。【解析】keep 是保持类系动词，表语 calm 说明状态维持。

multipleChoice.sentence: The old building ___ in good condition after the repair.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】修葺之后，这座老建筑仍然保持完好。【解析】remained 是保持类系动词，表语 in good condition 说明状态持续。

multipleChoice.sentence: The leaves ___ yellow in autumn every year.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】树叶每年秋天变黄。【解析】turn 是变化类系动词，表语 yellow 说明自然变化过程。

multipleChoice.sentence: You ___ very quiet today. Is everything okay?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你今天看起来很安静。一切都好吗？【解析】look 是感官系动词，表语 quiet 说明外观/状态特征。

multipleChoice.sentence: My mother ___ me a new coat for my birthday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我妈妈给我买了一件新外套作为生日礼物。【解析】bought 是过去式，me 是间接宾语，a new coat 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: Could you ___ me your dictionary for a moment?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你能把你的字典借我用一下吗？【解析】lend 接双宾语，me 是间接宾语，your dictionary 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: The teacher ___ the students a very interesting story yesterday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】老师昨天给学生们讲了一个很有趣的故事。【解析】told 是过去式，the students 是间接宾语，a story 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: My grandma always ___ me some pocket money on weekends.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我奶奶总是每周末给我一些零花钱。【解析】gives 是一般现在时，me 是间接宾语，some pocket money 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ her friend a postcard from Paris last month.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她上个月从巴黎给朋友寄了一张明信片。【解析】sent 是过去式，her friend 是间接宾语，a postcard 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: My father ___ me a new phone for my graduation.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我爸爸答应给我一部新手机作为毕业礼物。【解析】promised 是过去式，me 是间接宾语，a new phone 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: The waiter ___ us the menu as soon as we sat down.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们一坐下服务员就把菜单拿给了我们。【解析】brought 是过去式，us 是间接宾语，the menu 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ my sister a birthday card every year.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我每年都给姐姐寄一张生日贺卡。【解析】send 是一般现在时，my sister 是间接宾语，a birthday card 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: The company ___ its employees a big bonus this year.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这家公司今年给员工发了一大笔奖金。【解析】has offered 是现在完成时，its employees 是间接宾语，a big bonus 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: My aunt ___ me a beautiful scarf from her trip.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我姑姑旅行回来给我带了一条漂亮的围巾。【解析】brought 是过去式，me 是间接宾语，a beautiful scarf 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: The manager ___ me a chance to work in his team.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】经理给了我一个在他团队工作的机会。【解析】gave 是过去式，me 是间接宾语，a chance 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ my friend a message to tell her the news.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我给朋友发了一条消息告诉她这个消息。【解析】sent 是过去式，my friend 是间接宾语，a message 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: The teacher ___ each student a copy of the new book.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】老师给了每个学生一本新书的副本。【解析】gave 是过去式，each student 是间接宾语，a copy 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: My parents ___ me a wonderful childhood.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我的父母给了我一个美好的童年。【解析】have given 是现在完成时，me 是间接宾语，a wonderful childhood 是直接宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ our classroom clean every day.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们每天都保持教室干净。【解析】keep 是谓语，our classroom 是宾语，clean 是宾补，说明宾语的状态。

multipleChoice.sentence: The news ___ her very sad.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这个消息让她非常难过。【解析】makes 是谓语，her 是宾语，sad 是宾补，说明宾语的情绪变化。

multipleChoice.sentence: My mother ___ me to finish my homework first.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我妈妈想让我先完成作业。【解析】wants 是谓语，me 是宾语，to finish my homework 是宾补（不定式作宾补）。

multipleChoice.sentence: The teacher ___ the students to read the passage aloud.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】老师让学生们大声朗读那篇文章。【解析】asked 是谓语，the students 是宾语，to read the passage aloud 是宾补（不定式作宾补）。

multipleChoice.sentence: We all ___ him a good student.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们都认为他是个好学生。【解析】consider 是谓语，him 是宾语，a good student 是宾补（名词作宾补）。

multipleChoice.sentence: The story ___ everyone laughing.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那个故事让每个人都笑了。【解析】made 是谓语，everyone 是宾语，laughing 是宾补（现在分词作宾补，表示正在进行的动作）。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ my bedroom pink last summer.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我去年夏天把我的卧室刷成了粉色。【解析】painted 是谓语，my bedroom 是宾语，pink 是宾补，说明颜色的变化。

multipleChoice.sentence: The boss ___ the workers work overtime every day.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】老板每天让工人们加班。【解析】makes 是谓语，the workers 是宾语，work 是宾补（不定式省略 to）。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ the door open so that fresh air could come in.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我让门开着，好让新鲜空气进来。【解析】left 是谓语，the door 是宾语，open 是宾补（形容词作宾补）。

multipleChoice.sentence: My parents ___ me to study abroad next year.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我的父母鼓励我明年出国留学。【解析】encourage 是谓语，me 是宾语，to study abroad 是宾补（不定式作宾补）。

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ her hair cut short last week.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她上周剪了短发。【解析】had 是谓语，her hair 是宾语，cut 是宾补（过去分词作宾补，表被动）。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ the movie very interesting.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们觉得那部电影很有趣。【解析】find 是谓语，the movie 是宾语，very interesting 是宾补（形容词作宾补）。

multipleChoice.sentence: The noise ___ it hard for me to concentrate.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】噪音让我很难集中注意力。【解析】makes 是谓语，it 是形式宾语，hard 是宾补，to concentrate 是真正宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ him our class monitor yesterday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们昨天选他当我们的班长。【解析】elected 是谓语，him 是宾语，our class monitor 是宾补（名词作宾补）。

multipleChoice.sentence: The cat ___ me awake early this morning.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那只猫今天一大早就把我弄醒了。【解析】woke 是谓语，me 是宾语，awake 是宾补（形容词作宾补）。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ beautiful day it is!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】多美的一天啊！【解析】day 是可数名词单数，用 What a + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ fast the train is running!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】火车开得多快啊！【解析】fast 是副词，修饰动词 running，用 How + 副词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ lovely flowers you have in your garden!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你花园里的花多漂亮啊！【解析】flowers 是可数名词复数，用 What + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ hard-working students they are!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他们是多勤奋的学生啊！【解析】students 是可数名词复数，用 What + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ interesting story he told us!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他给我们讲了一个多有趣的故事啊！【解析】story 是可数名词单数，interesting 以元音音素开头，用 What an。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ terrible weather we are having!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们正赶上多糟糕的天气啊！【解析】weather 是不可数名词，用 What + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ carefully he drives his car!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他开车多小心啊！【解析】carefully 是副词，修饰动词 drives，用 How + 副词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ amazing performance the actors gave!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】演员们呈现了多精彩的表演啊！【解析】performance 是可数名词单数，amazing 以元音音素开头，用 What an。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ fast time passes!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】时间过得真快啊！【解析】fast 是副词，修饰动词 passes，用 How + 副词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ noisy children they are!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】多吵闹的孩子们啊！【解析】children 是可数名词复数，用 What + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ kind woman she is!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她是多善良的女人啊！【解析】woman 是可数名词单数，用 What a + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ quickly the little boy learned to swim!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那个小男孩学游泳多快啊！【解析】quickly 是副词，修饰动词 learned，用 How + 副词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ fresh air we breathe in the countryside!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们在乡下呼吸的空气多新鲜啊！【解析】air 是不可数名词，用 What + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ useful advice you gave me!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你给我提的建议多有用啊！【解析】advice 是不可数名词，用 What + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ tall the building is!
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那栋楼多高啊！【解析】tall 是形容词，说明 building 的特征，用 How + 形容词 + 主谓结构。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ quiet in the library, please.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】请在图书馆里保持安静。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Keep 表示“保持”，please 表示礼貌语气。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ the lights before you leave the classroom.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】离开教室前关灯。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Turn off 是“关闭”的动词短语。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ your homework on time.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】按时交作业。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Hand in 是“上交”的动词短语。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ to me carefully when I'm explaining.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我解释的时候认真听我说。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Listen to 表示“听”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ late for the meeting tomorrow morning.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】明天上午开会不要迟到。【解析】祈使句否定式用 Don't + 动词原形，Don't be late 是固定表达。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ the window and let some fresh air in.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Open 表示“打开”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ your name on the paper, please.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】请在纸上写下你的名字。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Write 表示“写”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ your hands before dinner.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】饭前洗手。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Wash 表示“洗”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ the box carefully. It's fragile.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】小心搬运这个箱子。它容易碎。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Handle 表示“搬运/处理”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ in the hallway. It's against the rules.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】不要在走廊里跑。这是违反规定的。【解析】祈使句否定式用 Don't + 动词原形，Don't run 表示“不要跑”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ your shoes before you come in.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】进来之前把鞋脱掉。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Take off 是“脱掉”的动词短语。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ the book to the library when you finish reading.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】看完后把书还给图书馆。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Return 表示“归还”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ me a call when you get home.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】到家后给我打个电话。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Give me a call 是“打电话”的口语表达。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ to your teacher politely.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】礼貌地和老师说话。【解析】祈使句以动词原形开头，Speak 表示“说话”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ too much time playing video games.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】不要花太多时间玩电子游戏。【解析】祈使句否定式用 Don't + 动词原形，Don't spend 表示“不要花”。

multipleChoice.sentence: The Earth ___ around the sun.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】地球绕着太阳转。【解析】陈述句描述客观事实，用一般现在时，主语 The Earth 是单数，谓语用 moves。

multipleChoice.sentence: My family ___ dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我家每天晚上七点吃晚饭。【解析】陈述句描述日常习惯，主语 My family 是复数，谓语用原形 have。

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ a new car last month.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她上个月买了一辆新车。【解析】陈述句描述过去事件，last month 表示过去时间，谓语用 bought。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ to the park every weekend.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们每周末都去公园。【解析】陈述句描述习惯性动作，主语 We 是复数，谓语用原形 go。

multipleChoice.sentence: My mother ___ a cake in the kitchen now.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我妈妈现在正在厨房里做蛋糕。【解析】now 表示现在进行时，主语 My mother 是单数，谓语用 is making。

multipleChoice.sentence: They ___ their homework yet.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他们还没完成作业。【解析】yet 常与现在完成时连用，否定式用 haven't finished。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ my keys. I can't find them anywhere.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我把钥匙弄丢了。我到处都找不到。【解析】强调对现在的影响（找不到钥匙），用现在完成时 have lost。

multipleChoice.sentence: He ___ to London three years ago.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他三年前搬到了伦敦。【解析】ago 表示过去时间点，谓语用过去式 moved。

multipleChoice.sentence: She ___ music when she was a child.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她小时候学过音乐。【解析】when she was a child 表示过去，用一般过去时 studied。

multipleChoice.sentence: The teacher ___ us a lot of homework every day.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】老师每天给我们布置很多作业。【解析】every day 表示一般现在时，主语 The teacher 是单数，谓语用 gives。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ___ dinner when the phone rang.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】电话响的时候我正在吃晚饭。【解析】when the phone rang 表示过去某一刻，正在进行的动作用过去进行时 was having。

multipleChoice.sentence: My sister ___ in Beijing since 2015.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我妹妹从2015年起就住在北京。【解析】since 2015 表示从过去持续到现在的动作，用现在完成时 has lived。

multipleChoice.sentence: We ___ a good time at the party last night.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】昨晚我们在派对上玩得很开心。【解析】last night 表示过去时间，谓语用过去式 had。

multipleChoice.sentence: He ___ a doctor when he grows up.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他长大后想当一名医生。【解析】描述未来的愿望，主句用一般现在时，主语 He 是三单，谓语用 wants。

multipleChoice.sentence: The train ___ at 8 a.m. every day.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】火车每天早上八点发车。【解析】every day 表示客观时间表，用一般现在时，主语 The train 是三单，谓语用 leaves。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Are these your books? —No, ___. They are hers.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——这些是你的书吗？——不，不是。它们是她的。【解析】疑问句主语为these，答语中用人称代词they替代，否定回答用they aren't[citation:1][citation:8]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —___ you like Guozhuang? —Yes, I like it very much.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——你喜欢锅庄舞吗？——是的，我非常喜欢。【解析】实义动词like作谓语，一般疑问句借助助动词Do构成，主语为you[citation:2]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Is there a watermelon on the table? —___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——桌子上有西瓜吗？——是的，有。【解析】There be句型的疑问句，肯定回答用Yes, there is，不可用it替代[citation:8]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —___ under the tree? —No, they aren't.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——它们在树下吗？——不，它们不在。【解析】答语they aren't提示主语为复数且为一般疑问句，Are they符合[citation:1][citation:4]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Did he visit the park yesterday? —___. He was on the farm.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——他昨天参观公园了吗？——不，他没有。他在农场。【解析】一般过去时疑问句用Did提问，否定回答用No, he didn't[citation:2]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Is this your jacket? —No, ___. Mine is in my schoolbag.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——这是你的夹克吗？——不，不是。我的在书包里。【解析】this提问，答语用人称代词it替代，否定回答用it isn't[citation:5]。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ you have a computer? —No, I ___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——你有电脑吗？——不，我没有。【解析】实义动词have用Do提问，否定回答用don't[citation:4]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Will you go boating this Sunday? —___. We will camp in the mountain.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——这周日你们去划船吗？——不，不去。我们要去山上露营。【解析】Will提问一般将来时，否定回答用No, we won't[citation:7]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Would you like to go for a walk with me? —___. But I have to clean the living room first.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——你愿意和我去散步吗？——我愿意。但我得先打扫客厅。【解析】Would you like...的肯定回答常用Yes, I'd love to[citation:7][citation:10]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Could you please give out food at the food bank? —___. I will get there on time.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——你能去食品银行分发食物吗？——是的，我能。我会准时到。【解析】Could提问表示委婉请求，肯定回答用Yes, I can[citation:7]。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ there any boys in the room?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】房间里有一些男孩吗？【解析】any boys为复数，There be疑问句用Are there开头[citation:4]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —___ everyone have a good time? —Yes, everything ___ really great.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——大家都玩得开心吗？——是的，一切都很棒。【解析】have为实义动词，过去时用Did提问；everything为单数，回答用was[citation:7]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Are your pencils under the chair? —___. They're in the pencil box.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——你的铅笔在椅子下面吗？——不，不在。它们在铅笔盒里。【解析】复数pencils用they替代，否定回答用they aren't[citation:1]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Is that building a library? —___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——那栋楼是图书馆吗？——不，不是。【解析】that building答语用it替代，否定回答用No, it isn't[citation:4]。

multipleChoice.sentence: —___ your father going to Australia? —No, he is going to China.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——你父亲要去澳大利亚吗？——不，他要去中国。【解析】be going to结构，主语father为单数，疑问句用Is[citation:3]。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ do you usually go to school? —By bike.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你通常怎么去学校？——骑自行车。【解析】回答By bike表示交通方式，疑问词用How。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ is your best friend? —The boy in blue over there.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】谁是你最好的朋友？——那边穿蓝衣服的男孩。【解析】回答指人，疑问词用Who。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ did you put my keys? —I put them on the table.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你把我的钥匙放哪儿了？——我放在桌上了。【解析】回答地点on the table，疑问词用Where。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ do you like pandas? —Because they are very cute.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你为什么喜欢熊猫？——因为它们很可爱。【解析】回答以Because开头，疑问词用Why。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ book is this? —It's my sister's.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这是谁的书？——是我妹妹的。【解析】回答my sister's表示所属关系，疑问词用Whose。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ does your father go to work every morning? —At 7:30.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你爸爸每天早上几点去上班？——七点半。【解析】回答具体时间At 7:30，疑问词用When。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ is the weather like today? —It's sunny.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】今天天气怎么样？——天气晴朗。【解析】询问天气常用What's the weather like?，疑问词用What。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ of the two dresses do you prefer? —The red one.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这两条裙子你更喜欢哪一条？——红色的那条。【解析】of the two表示在两者中选择，疑问词用Which。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ is your new teacher? —She is very kind and patient.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你的新老师怎么样？——她很善良且耐心。【解析】回答用kind and patient描述性格特征，疑问词用How。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ did you start learning English? —When I was eight years old.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你什么时候开始学英语的？——我八岁的时候。【解析】回答When I was eight表示时间，疑问词用When。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ your brother like tea ___ coffee?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你哥哥喜欢茶还是咖啡？【解析】选择疑问句用or连接两个选项，主语your brother是单数，助动词用Does。

multipleChoice.sentence: Which do you prefer, apples ___ bananas?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你更喜欢哪一个，苹果还是香蕉？【解析】选择疑问句用or连接两个名词，表示在两者之间选择。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ we go out for dinner ___ cook at home?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们是出去吃饭还是在家做饭？【解析】Shall we...or...表示征求意见，选择疑问句固定结构，用or连接两个选项。

multipleChoice.sentence: —Is she a teacher ___ a doctor? —She is a doctor.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】——她是一名老师还是医生？——她是一名医生。【解析】选择疑问句用or连接两个职业选项，回答选择其中一个。

multipleChoice.sentence: Would you like some water ___ juice?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你想要一些水还是果汁？【解析】选择疑问句用or连接两个饮品，询问对方的选择。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ the movie was boring ___ exciting?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那部电影是无聊还是精彩？【解析】主语the movie是单数，be动词用Was，选择疑问句用or连接两个形容词。

multipleChoice.sentence: Do you want to go swimming ___ stay at home?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你想去游泳还是待在家里？【解析】选择疑问句用or连接两个动词短语，表示两种活动选择。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ your sister ___ your brother at home?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你姐姐还是你哥哥在家？【解析】选择疑问句在两者中选择，主语your sister是单数，be动词用Is。

multipleChoice.sentence: Did you go to the park ___ the museum yesterday?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你昨天去了公园还是博物馆？【解析】选择疑问句用or连接两个地点名词，表示在两个地点之间选择。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ shall we go, by bus ___ by train?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们该怎么去，坐公交还是坐火车？【解析】询问交通方式用How，选择疑问句用or连接两个交通方式选项。

multipleChoice.sentence: She's never been to Shanghai, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她从没去过上海，是吗？【解析】反意疑问句前否后肯，陈述句中有never（否定词），后面用肯定 has she。

multipleChoice.sentence: He plays the piano very well, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他钢琴弹得很好，不是吗？【解析】前肯后否，陈述句用plays，助动词用does，后面用doesn't he。

multipleChoice.sentence: There is a big tree in front of the house, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】房子前面有一棵大树，是吗？【解析】There be 句型的反意疑问句，前肯后否，用isn't there。

multipleChoice.sentence: Let's go to the park together, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们一起去公园吧，好吗？【解析】Let's 开头表示包含听话者在内的建议，反意疑问句用shall we。

multipleChoice.sentence: I don't think he can finish the work on time, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我认为他不能按时完成这项工作，是吗？【解析】主句为I think...且为否定形式，反意疑问句从句主语和谓语变化，前否后肯，用can he。

multipleChoice.sentence: She had a good time at the party, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她在派对上玩得很开心，不是吗？【解析】had 作实义动词“度过”，助动词用did，前肯后否用didn't she。

multipleChoice.sentence: They have never been to Beijing, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他们从没去过北京，是吗？【解析】陈述句中有never（否定词），反意疑问句前否后肯，用have they。

multipleChoice.sentence: You would like some coffee, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你想来点咖啡，是吧？【解析】前肯后否，情态动词would后加not，用wouldn't you。

multipleChoice.sentence: Everything is ready for the trip, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】旅行的所有东西都准备好了，是吗？【解析】不定代词everything作主语，反意疑问句用单数it，前肯后否用isn't it。

multipleChoice.sentence: He used to live in the countryside, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他过去住在乡下，不是吗？【解析】used to 有两种反意疑问形式，实际考试中常用didn't he。

multipleChoice.sentence: She will go to the zoo tomorrow, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她明天会去动物园，不是吗？【解析】前肯后否，情态动词will后加not，用won't she。

multipleChoice.sentence: I am your new classmate, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我是你的新同学，不是吗？【解析】am 的反意疑问句，后否形式用aren't I（口语用法）。

multipleChoice.sentence: The students have finished their homework, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】学生们已经完成了作业，不是吗？【解析】have done 现在完成时，前肯后否用haven't they。

multipleChoice.sentence: Nobody came to the meeting, ___?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】没有人来开会，是吗？【解析】Nobody 是否定不定代词，反意疑问句用肯定did they（they替代nobody）。

multipleChoice.sentence: There are two ___ on the table.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】桌上有两把刀。【解析】knife 是以 f 结尾的可数名词，复数需将 f 变为 v 再加 es，即 knives。

multipleChoice.sentence: I need to buy some ___ for my trip.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我需要为旅行买些东西（牙刷等），但此处考察牙齿复数。【解析】tooth 的复数形式是不规则变化 teeth，属常见考点。

multipleChoice.sentence: How many ___ are there in your school?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你们学校有多少位女教师？【解析】woman teacher 的复数形式需同时将 woman 和 teacher 都变为复数，即 women teachers。

multipleChoice.sentence: There are five ___ on the farm.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】农场里有五只羊。【解析】sheep 的单复数同形，复数不加 s。

multipleChoice.sentence: My sister has two ___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我姐姐有两个孩子。【解析】child 的复数形式是不规则变化 children。

multipleChoice.sentence: We saw some ___ in the zoo.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们在动物园里看到了一些狐狸。【解析】fox 以 x 结尾，复数加 es，即 foxes。

multipleChoice.sentence: He caught three ___ in the river.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他在河里抓到了三条鱼。【解析】fish 表示“鱼”时，单复数同形（three fish），表示“多种鱼类”时才用 fishes。

multipleChoice.sentence: There are many ___ in the basket.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】篮子里有很多土豆。【解析】potato 以 o 结尾，复数加 es，即 potatoes。

multipleChoice.sentence: My grandmother has a pair of ___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我奶奶有一副眼镜。【解析】glasses 表示“眼镜”时通常以复数形式出现，a pair of glasses 为固定搭配。

multipleChoice.sentence: There are three ___ in the picture.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】图片里有三个男人。【解析】man 的复数形式是不规则变化 men。

multipleChoice.sentence: The ___ are playing in the garden.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】孩子们正在花园里玩耍。【解析】主语为复数且为泛指，用 children，child 为单数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: I ate two ___ for breakfast.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我早餐吃了两个鸡蛋。【解析】egg 为普通可数名词，复数直接加 s。

multipleChoice.sentence: We need to buy some ___ for the party.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们需要为派对买些西红柿。【解析】tomato 以 o 结尾，复数加 es，即 tomatoes。

multipleChoice.sentence: My aunt has three ___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我阿姨有三个宝宝。【解析】baby 以辅音字母 + y 结尾，复数变 y 为 i 再加 es，即 babies。

multipleChoice.sentence: There are many ___ in the forest.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】森林里有很多鹿。【解析】deer 的单复数同形，复数不加 s。

multipleChoice.sentence: This is ___ bike. It's very new.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这是莉莉的自行车。它很新。【解析】单数名词所有格直接在词尾加's，Lily's表示"莉莉的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: The ___ room is very clean.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】女孩们的房间非常干净。【解析】复数名词以s结尾，所有格只在词尾加'，girls'表示"女孩们的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ car is parked outside the building.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】史密斯先生的车停在楼外。【解析】单数名词所有格加's，Mr. Smith's表示"史密斯先生的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: The ___ desks are in the classroom.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】学生们的书桌在教室里。【解析】复数名词students以s结尾，所有格加'，students'表示"学生们的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ mother is a famous doctor.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】汤姆的妈妈是一位著名的医生。【解析】单数名词所有格加's，Tom's表示"汤姆的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: The ___ homework is very difficult today.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】孩子们今天的作业很难。【解析】children本身是复数形式但不以s结尾，所有格加's，children's表示"孩子们的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: My ___ name is Lisa.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我朋友的名字是丽莎。【解析】单数名词friend加's，friend's表示"朋友的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: The ___ school is near the park.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】男孩们的学校在公园附近。【解析】复数名词boys以s结尾，所有格只加'，boys'表示"男孩们的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ books are on the table.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】玛丽的书在桌子上。【解析】单数名词所有格加's，Mary's表示"玛丽的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: This is a ___ store.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这是一家女士用品店。【解析】women是woman的复数形式但不以s结尾，所有格加's，women's表示"女士的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: The ___ toys are everywhere in the room.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】宝宝们的玩具在房间里到处都是。【解析】复数名词babies以s结尾，所有格加'，babies'表示"宝宝们的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ painting won the first prize.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】琳达的画获得了一等奖。【解析】单数名词所有格加's，Linda's表示"琳达的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: The ___ dog is very friendly.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】邻居的狗非常友好。【解析】单数名词neighbor加's，neighbor's表示"邻居的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: The ___ office is on the fifth floor.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】老师的办公室在五楼。【解析】单数名词teacher加's，teacher's表示"老师的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: The ___ house is very big.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】父母们的房子很大。【解析】复数名词parents以s结尾，所有格只加'，parents'表示"父母们的"。

multipleChoice.sentence: Could you give me some ___ on how to learn English?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你能给我一些关于如何学英语的建议吗？【解析】advice 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: I need to buy some ___ for breakfast.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我需要买一些面包当早餐。【解析】bread 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: There is too much ___ in the room.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】房间里太吵了。【解析】noise 作为“噪音”时通常用作不可数名词。

multipleChoice.sentence: We don't have enough ___ to finish the work.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们没有足够的时间完成这项工作。【解析】time 表示“时间”时为不可数名词。

multipleChoice.sentence: Please put some ___ in my cup.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】请在我的杯子里加些牛奶。【解析】milk 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: She gave me a piece of ___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她给了我一张纸。【解析】paper 表示“纸张”时为不可数名词。

multipleChoice.sentence: There is a lot of ___ in the river.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】河里有大量的水。【解析】water 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: I need some ___ for my coffee.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我需要一些糖加在我的咖啡里。【解析】sugar 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: We have a lot of ___ to do today.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们今天有很多作业要做。【解析】homework 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: There is not much ___ in this room.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这个房间里没有太多家具。【解析】furniture 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: Could you give me some ___ about the trip?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你能给我一些关于这次旅行的信息吗？【解析】information 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: There is a little ___ left in the bottle.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】瓶子里还剩一点果汁。【解析】juice 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。

multipleChoice.sentence: We need more ___ for the party.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们需要更多的食物来办派对。【解析】food 作为总称时通常用作不可数名词。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ is the capital of England.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】伦敦是英格兰的首都。【解析】London 是城市名，专有名词首字母大写，不加冠词。

multipleChoice.sentence: We are going to visit ___ next month.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们下个月要去参观颐和园。【解析】专有名词中实词首字母大写，the Summer Palace 是固定名称。

multipleChoice.sentence: The highest mountain in the world is ___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】世界上最高的山是珠穆朗玛峰。【解析】Mount Everest 是山峰专有名词，不加冠词。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ is on the east coast of China.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】上海位于中国东海岸。【解析】Shanghai 是城市名，专有名词不加冠词。

multipleChoice.sentence: We had dinner at ___ last night.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们昨晚在张先生家吃的晚饭。【解析】Mr. Zhang's 表示“张先生的家”，专有名词所有格。

multipleChoice.sentence: The famous writer comes from ___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】那位著名作家来自英国。【解析】the United Kingdom 是国名专有名词，需加定冠词 the。

multipleChoice.sentence: I received a postcard from ___ yesterday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我昨天收到了一张来自北京的明信片。【解析】Beijing 是城市名，不加冠词。

multipleChoice.sentence: They visited ___ during their holiday.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他们在假期中参观了伦敦塔。【解析】the Tower of London 是著名建筑专有名词，需加定冠词。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ is the largest ocean in the world.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】太平洋是世界上最大的海洋。【解析】The Pacific Ocean 是海洋专有名词，需加定冠词。

multipleChoice.sentence: My uncle works for ___.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我叔叔为微软工作。【解析】Microsoft 是公司名，专有名词不加冠词。

multipleChoice.sentence: There are ___ days in a week.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】一周有七天。【解析】基数词表示数量，seven 表示“七”。

multipleChoice.sentence: The train station is about ___ (3) kilometers away from here.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】火车站离这里大约三公里。【解析】基数词表示距离数量，three 表示“三”。

multipleChoice.sentence: My grandmother is ___ (80) years old this year.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我奶奶今年八十岁了。【解析】基数词表示年龄，eighty 表示“八十”。

multipleChoice.sentence: I have ___ (5) apples in my bag.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我书包里有五个苹果。【解析】基数词表示物品数量，five 表示“五”。

multipleChoice.sentence: The classroom has ___ (12) windows.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这个教室有十二扇窗户。【解析】基数词表示数量，twelve 表示“十二”。

multipleChoice.sentence: Today is my ___ (12) birthday. I'm twelve years old.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】今天是我十二岁生日。【解析】序数词表示顺序，twelfth 表示“第十二”。

multipleChoice.sentence: We live on the ___ (5) floor of that building.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们住在那栋楼的五楼。【解析】序数词表示楼层顺序，fifth 表示“第五”。

multipleChoice.sentence: This is the ___ (3) time I've visited this museum.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这是我第三次参观这个博物馆。【解析】序数词表示次数顺序，third 表示“第三”。

multipleChoice.sentence: She won the ___ (1) prize in the competition.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她在比赛中获得了一等奖。【解析】序数词表示名次顺序，first 表示“第一”。

multipleChoice.sentence: December is the ___ (12) month of the year.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】十二月是一年中的第十二个月。【解析】序数词表示月份顺序，twelfth 表示“第十二”。

multipleChoice.sentence: About ___ of the students in our class wear glasses.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们班大约四分之三的学生戴眼镜。【解析】分数表达中分子用基数词，分母用序数词，分子大于1时分母加s，three quarters 表示四分之三。

multipleChoice.sentence: I have eaten ___ of the cake.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我已经吃了蛋糕的三分之二。【解析】分子 two 大于1，分母 third 加 s，即 two thirds。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ of the earth is covered with water.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】地球四分之三被水覆盖。【解析】three fourths 是分数表达，相当于 three quarters。

multipleChoice.sentence: The price of this phone is ___ yuan.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这部手机的价格是一千八百元。【解析】英文中数字表达不加 and，直接 one thousand eight hundred。

multipleChoice.sentence: About 50 ___ of the students like sports.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】大约百分之五十的学生喜欢运动。【解析】percent 表示百分数，单复数同形，不加 s。

multipleChoice.sentence: We will have a meeting ___ May 1st.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们将在5月1日开会。【解析】具体日期前用on。

multipleChoice.sentence: I was born ___ 2000.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我出生在2000年。【解析】年份前用in。

multipleChoice.sentence: She goes to school ___ 7:00.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她七点去上学。【解析】具体时刻前用at。

multipleChoice.sentence: My birthday is ___ May.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我的生日在五月。【解析】月份前用in。

multipleChoice.sentence: The train leaves ___ 8:30.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】火车在八点半发车。【解析】具体时刻前用at。

multipleChoice.sentence: I like apples ___ bananas.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我喜欢苹果和香蕉。【解析】and 表示并列关系，连接两个相同成分。

multipleChoice.sentence: She is young ___ she knows a lot.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她年龄小，但懂得很多。【解析】but 表示转折关系，前后语义相反。

multipleChoice.sentence: We can go to the park ___ stay at home.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们可以去公园或待在家里。【解析】or 表示选择关系。

multipleChoice.sentence: He was tired, ___ he went to bed early.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他累了，所以早睡了。【解析】so 表示因果关系。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ he is young, he can speak three languages.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】虽然他很年轻，但他能说三种语言。【解析】Although 引导让步状语从句，表示"虽然"。

multipleChoice.sentence: I'll call you ___ I get home.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我一到家就给你打电话。【解析】as soon as 表示"一……就……"，引导时间状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ it was raining, we stayed at home.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】因为下雨，我们待在家里。【解析】Because 引导原因状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: I don't know ___ he will come.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我不知道他是否会来。【解析】whether 表示"是否"，常用于宾语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: Please turn off the lights ___ you leave the room.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你离开房间前请关灯。【解析】before 引导时间状语从句，表示"在……之前"。

multipleChoice.sentence: He didn't go to school ___ he was ill.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他没去上学，因为他生病了。【解析】because 引导原因状语从句，解释原因。

multipleChoice.sentence: I must hurry, ___ I'll be late.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我必须快点，否则会迟到。【解析】or表示否则。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ you work hard, you will succeed.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】如果你努力，你就会成功。【解析】If引导条件状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: We were playing outside ___ it started to rain.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我们正在外面玩，突然下起雨来了。【解析】when表示“当……时”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ he arrived, we had already left.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】当他到达时，我们已经离开了。【解析】When引导时间状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: I'll stay here ___ you come back.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我会在这里等到你回来。【解析】until表示“直到”。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ she was cooking, I was reading.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她做饭的时候，我在看书。【解析】While引导时间状语从句，强调两个动作同时进行。

multipleChoice.sentence: He ran fast ___ he could catch the bus.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他跑得很快以便能赶上公交车。【解析】so that引导目的状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: She said ___ she would come to the party.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她说她会来参加派对。【解析】that引导陈述性宾语从句，在从句中不作成分。

multipleChoice.sentence: I don't know ___ he is.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我不知道他在哪里。【解析】where引导宾语从句，在从句中作地点状语。

multipleChoice.sentence: Could you tell me ___ the nearest bank is?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你能告诉我最近的银行在哪里吗？【解析】where引导宾语从句，询问地点。

multipleChoice.sentence: He asked me ___ I could help him.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他问我是否能帮助他。【解析】if引导宾语从句，表示“是否”。

multipleChoice.sentence: I wonder ___ he is doing now.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我想知道他现在在做什么。【解析】what引导宾语从句，在从句中作doing的宾语。

multipleChoice.sentence: She told me ___ she had finished her homework.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她告诉我她已经完成了作业。【解析】that引导陈述性宾语从句，从句中句子成分完整。

multipleChoice.sentence: Can you tell me ___ the bus leaves?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你能告诉我公交车什么时候开吗？【解析】when引导宾语从句，询问时间。

multipleChoice.sentence: I think ___ he is right.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】我认为他是对的。【解析】that引导宾语从句，think后接陈述内容。

multipleChoice.sentence: She asked ___ I had finished my homework.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她问我是否完成了作业。【解析】if引导宾语从句，表示“是否”。

multipleChoice.sentence: Do you know ___ she is?
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】你知道她是谁吗？【解析】who引导宾语从句，在从句中作表语。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ he is young, he knows a lot.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】虽然他很年轻，但他懂得很多。【解析】Although引导让步状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: She has lived here ___ she was a child.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】她从小就住在这里。【解析】since引导时间状语从句，表示"自从"。

multipleChoice.sentence: The box is ___ heavy that I can't carry it.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。【解析】so...that引导结果状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: You will be late ___ you hurry up.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】除非你快点，否则你会迟到。【解析】unless引导条件状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: ___ the sun is shining, it is still cold.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】虽然阳光明媚，但还是冷。【解析】Although引导让步状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: I'll give it to him ___ he comes.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】他来了我就给他。【解析】when引导时间状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: We'll go swimming ___ it's warm enough.
multipleChoice.explanation: 【题意】如果天气足够暖和，我们就去游泳。【解析】if引导条件状语从句。

multipleChoice.sentence: The man ___ is standing there is my teacher.
